title: Partner Sales Specialist
why_it_fits: Content Specialist match. 4 skills: crm, salesforce, excel, saas. Yes PH eligibility signal
position_overview: Job Description Partner Sales Specialist About Accruent At Accruent, our mission is to transform the way organizations manage their built environment. Through data-led intelligence, we help people and systems work together more effectively, driving business forward. With over 4,000 customers across 149 countries, our cloud-based solutions enable organizations to optimize real estate, facilities, and asset management-delivering real value through efficiency, compliance, and performance. The Role The Partner Sales Specialist is responsible for managing and optimizing the operational backbone of the partner ecosystem. This role ensures a seamless partner experience across quoting, renewals, onboarding, and lifecycle management, while driving efficiency through process excellence and continuous improvement. This individual partners cross-functionally with the Partner Team, Deal Enablement, Order Management, Revenue Operations, Technology Partnerships, and Finance to drive operational rigor, visibility, and consistency across all partner-facing processes, while helping operationalize evolving partner program initiatives. What You'll Do Support and optimize back-end partner operations across recruiting, onboarding, growth, and renewals Continuously improve operational processes to enhance partner experience and internal efficiency Drive the quote-to-order process for partner deals, including coordination across systems and teams to enable fast and accurate execution Manage and optimize renewals workflows to improve retention, minimize churn, and enhance forecast accuracy Establish proactive renewal management practices (e.g., daily/visual management) to prevent late or missed renewals Design and implement automated workflows to reduce manual effort and increase scalability of partner support Leverage the Fortive Business System (FBS), Lean, or similar methodologies to continuously improve processes and eliminate waste Document and evolve standard work for quoting, renewals, and partner operations Manage lead routing, tracking, and attribution for partner-driven opportunities Serve as the primary liaison with technical teams for partner portal development, ongoing management, and issue resolution Drive portal enhancements to improve usability, self-service, and partner engagement Refine and operationalize the partner onboarding program to accelerate time-to-revenue

raw_description: Job Description Partner Sales Specialist About Accruent At Accruent, our mission is to transform the way organizations manage their built environment. Through data-led intelligence, we help people and systems work together more effectively, driving business forward. With over 4,000 customers across 149 countries, our cloud-based solutions enable organizations to optimize real estate, facilities, and asset management-delivering real value through efficiency, compliance, and performance. The Role The Partner Sales Specialist is responsible for managing and optimizing the operational backbone of the partner ecosystem. This role ensures a seamless partner experience across quoting, renewals, onboarding, and lifecycle management, while driving efficiency through process excellence and continuous improvement. This individual partners cross-functionally with the Partner Team, Deal Enablement, Order Management, Revenue Operations, Technology Partnerships, and Finance to drive operational rigor, visibility, and consistency across all partner-facing processes, while helping operationalize evolving partner program initiatives. What You'll Do Support and optimize back-end partner operations across recruiting, onboarding, growth, and renewals Continuously improve operational processes to enhance partner experience and internal efficiency Drive the quote-to-order process for partner deals, including coordination across systems and teams to enable fast and accurate execution Manage and optimize renewals workflows to improve retention, minimize churn, and enhance forecast accuracy Establish proactive renewal management practices (e.g., daily/visual management) to prevent late or missed renewals Design and implement automated workflows to reduce manual effort and increase scalability of partner support Leverage the Fortive Business System (FBS), Lean, or similar methodologies to continuously improve processes and eliminate waste Document and evolve standard work for quoting, renewals, and partner operations Manage lead routing, tracking, and attribution for partner-driven opportunities Serve as the primary liaison with technical teams for partner portal development, ongoing management, and issue resolution Drive portal enhancements to improve usability, self-service, and partner engagement Refine and operationalize the partner onboarding program to accelerate time-to-revenue Partner with the Enablement team to develop scalable onboarding and training content Design and implement systems to track onboarding progress, completion rates, and performance Partner with leadership to operationalize evolving partner program structures, policies and requirements Ensure systems, processes, and reporting scale to support future program enhancements What We're Looking For Must have: 5+ years of experience in Partner Operations, Sales Operations, or Business Operations (preferably in a SaaS or channel-driven environment) Strong experience with CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce) and partner portals Expert in quote and renewal processing Demonstrated expertise in workflow automation, process design, and optimization Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and drive alignment Ability to operate both strategically and tactically in a fast-paced environment Comfort working in ambiguity with aggressive timelines Nice to have: Experience supporting channel / partner ecosystems at scale Familiarity with deal registration, renewal management, and partner lifecycle workflows Experience optimizing or scaling partner programs What We Offer A dynamic, international team environment with colleagues across the globe. Opportunities to develop, grow, and build your success in a fast-moving SaaS company. Competitive remuneration and benefits package. An inclusive culture where new ideas and initiatives are welcomed, and your work has real impact. Fortive Corporation Overview Fortive's essential technology makes the world safer and more productive. We accelerate transformation in high-impact fields like workplace safety, build environments, and healthcare. We are a global industrial technology innovator with a startup spirit. Our forward-looking companies lead the way in healthcare sterilization, industrial safety, predictive maintenance, and other mission-critical solutions. We're a force for progress, working alongside our customers and partners to solve challenges on a global scale, from workplace safety in the most demanding conditions to advanced technologies that help providers focus on exceptional patient care. We are a diverse team 10,000 strong, united by a dynamic, inclusive culture and energized by limitless learning and growth. We use the proven Fortive Business System (FBS) to accelerate our positive impact. At Fortive, we believe in you. We believe in your potential-your ability to learn, grow, and make a difference. At Fortive, we believe in us. We believe in the power of people working together to solve problems no one could solve alone. At Fortive, we believe in growth. We're honest about what's working and what isn't, and we never stop improving and innovating. Fortive: For you, for us, for growth. About Accruent Personal development and becoming the best you is all about growth and exploring new skills and opportunities - both in and out of the office. At Accruent, we call this Grow Without Limits, and we're proud to offer each of our employees the resources, coaching and support necessary to achieve Growth Without Limits in their personal and professional lives. Explore where the path takes you. Accruent is a leading provider of solutions for unifying the built environment -spanning real estate, physical and digital assets, and the integrated technology systems that connect and control them. Accruent continues to set new expectations for how organizations can use data to transform how they manage their facilities and assets. With U.S. headquarters in Austin, Texas, Accruent serves over 5,000 customers in a wide range of industries in more than 100 countries worldwide. We Are an Equal Opportunity Employer. Fortive Corporation and all Fortive Companies are proud to be equal opportunity employers. We value and encourage diversity and solicit applications from all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, age, marital status, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or other characteristics protected by law. Fortive and all Fortive Companies are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities. Individuals who need a reasonable accommodation because of a disability for any part of the employment application process, please contact us at applyassistance@fortive.com. Bonus or Equity This position is also eligible for bonus as part of the total compensation package.
